text:
maria: Heads-up — saw a ~30% p90 latency regression on the int4/fp8 autotune path for short sequences (seq <= 8) after yesterday's runtime deploy. Repro on sm95 and h100-rt.

devin: ugh. Any profile or flamegraphs? :eyes:

maria: Pasted a tiny snippet from the probe logs: 
```
[perf] seq=8 model=redwood-13B quant=int4 pick=int4_opt_v2 kernel_time=4.2ms kv_miss_rate=0.42 swap_count=3
[perf] seq=12 model=redwood-13B quant=fp8 pick=fp8_mixed kernel_time=3.8ms kv_miss_rate=0.05 swap_count=1
[perf] seq=8 model=redwood-13B quant=int4 pick=int4_opt_v2 kernel_time=4.5ms kv_miss_rate=0.47 swap_count=4
```

maria: Flamegraph shows hot section in kernel selection hotpath — frequent back-and-forth between int4_opt_v2 and fp8_fallback plus KV cache misses spiking when int4 wins.

irene: Can you paste the autotune heuristic/config we shipped? My guess is seq thresholds or kv_warmup tradeoffs got tweaked.

maria: Current autotune snippet (from configstore): `heuristics: { seq_thresholds: [ {max_seq: 10, prefer: 'int4_opt_v2'}, {max_seq: 64, prefer: 'fp8_mixed'} ], kv_warmup_ms: 30, bucket_margin: 0.15 }`

devin: That kv_warmup_ms=30 is too low for bursty short-seq workloads — KV cache isn't primed so int4 uses a smaller workspace but suffers from repeated cache misses and kernel swap overhead. Suggest bump to 120ms and add a small seq_bias so picks favor fp8 for seqs that cause swap_count>1.

liam: FWIW we've seen elevated cudaMalloc churn on sm92 with int4_opt_v2 when swaps happen; could be workspace size calc bug when switching kernels mid-request.

maria: Good note. I'll open a repro with malloc logging. Meanwhile I'll launch a controlled probe (A/B) with kv_warmup_ms=120 and seq_bias=+0.1 on the sm95 pool, 5k requests. cc @perf-bot

perf-bot: Probe job started — probe_id=px-2141-01, targets=[sm95,h100-rt], runs=5000, seed=42, config_overrides={kv_warmup_ms:120, seq_bias:0.1}

devin: Also add `kernel_swap_count` to exported metrics (we currently only emit kernel_time and kv_miss_rate). That will make the thrash obvious in the dashboard.

maria: Good call — adding kernel_swap_count to the probe events. If we see >10% p90 reduction we'll promote to canary.

irene: One more: add hysteresis to the picker — require 3 consecutive samples favoring a switch before flipping. Should reduce oscillation for short sessions.

devin: :thumbsup: I'll open a tiny PR to autotuner rules: bump warmup, add seq_bias, hysteresis window=3, emit swap metric.

maria: Thanks — monitoring dashboard `autotune/quant-sampler-warmstart` and logs at /tmp/probes/px-2141-01/*. Will post results when probe finishes.

liam: If the probe reproduces, also capture workspace_size histograms per kernel. Could confirm the cudaMalloc hypothesis.

maria: Yup will add workspace histos. Back soon with numbers.
